text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah... hey.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...I'd like to stop by the bookstore for a 
bit.

And so, we came to a shopping mall that 
had a bookstore.
choice_data_list: What book are you going to buy?
What book are you going to buy?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Nn... No, it's not for me—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...This doesn't concern you. It won't take 
long, so wait here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...See ya.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...What a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You're right.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Umm... well then.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ……Aaargh, listen to me!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmm...? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Um, hey... are the books on that shelf the 
series that Hayahide's collecting?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Mmhâ¦â¦ Ah, that's right. I remember 
seeing them lined up on the shelves.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Are you giving that to someone?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Well, now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide can be an annoying meddler at 
times, long-winded, and totally 
overcomplicated, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You've... really done a lot for me, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That's true...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Sis meddles way too much, she phrases 
things in the most annoying ways, and her 
thought process is convoluted, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I, too—have been in their care.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey. Could you pick out some other 
books that she might like?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I can keep you company for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting. ...Let's head home.

"...To be honest, I couldn't help but 
overhear your conversation with Narita 
Brian, but..."

"...To be honest, I couldn't help but 
overhear your conversation with Narita 
Brian, but..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh!? W-What are you talking about!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I told you it doesn't matter, I'll kick 
your butt!!

...I ended up making her angry, but 
somehow, even that was rather endearing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Do you have any favorite books too?

On the way home that day, it felt like our 
conversation was just a little livelier 
than usual.
